reader.requirement: At --std 85, PRESENT-VALUE must compute the sum of argument-2/(1+argument-1)**n for every argument-1 greater than -1 (including rates arbitrarily close to -1; items, literals, expressions and table ALL references including OCCURS DEPENDING ON); for argument-1 <= -1 the result is undefined (A.2.2), so any result without failure conforms.

reader.notes: The domain screen runs on the exact rate before binary64 narrowing and the discount base is formed exactly, so legal rates near -1 compute correctly; an illegal rate yields 0 through ArgumentError (unchecked at 85), which the 1985 text leaves undefined.
